senses.gloss: (a-ṛṇa) adj. [a for an] without debts, free from debts श्राद्धं… कार्यम्…। सऋणैरऋणैः सर्वैः JayāS. 23. 2.

(a-ṛṇin) adj. [a before a vowel] having no debts, free from debts or obligations दिवसस्याष्टमे भागे शाकं पचति यो नरः। अऋणी चाप्रवासी च स वारिचर मोदते [quoted from MahāBhā. by ŚabdKaDru. and Vāc. but not traceable]
